newsitem.title: EU: Official Journal contents - OJ L 160 of June 18, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Official Journal contents - OJ L 160 of June 18, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

COMMISSION DECISION of 13 June 1997 on marking and use of pigmeat in application of Article 9 of Council Directive 80/217/EEC concerning Belgium and repealing Decision 97/294/EC (Text with EEA relevance) (97/381/EC)

COMMISSION DECISION of 4 June 1997 authorizing the Member States to permit temporarily the marketing of seed of Timothy (Phleum bertolonii DC) not satisfying the requirements of Council Directive 66/401/EEC (97/380/EC)

COMMISSION DECISION of 4 June 1997 authorizing the Member States to permit temporarily the marketing of seed of soja bean (Glycine max (L.) Merr.) not satisfying the requirements of Council Directive 69/208/EEC (97/379/EC)
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1102/97 of 17 June 1997 amending the import duties in the cereals sector
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1101/97 of 17 June 1997 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1100/97 of 17 June 1997 amending Regulation (EC) No 2805/95 fixing the export refunds in the wine sector

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1099/97 of 17 June 1997 fixing representative prices and additional import duties in the poultrymeat and egg sectors and for egg albumin, and amending Regulation (EC) No 1484/95 END OF DOCUMENT.
